<action>batch_retrieve_polymorphs</action>

    "Ta2O5","Bi2O3","Ga2O3","In2O3","CdO","HgO","Ag2O","Au2O3","PdO","PtO2",
    "FeO","Co3O4","Ni2O3","Mn2O3","CrO3","SiO","GeO2","SnO","PbO","Cu2O"
  ],
  "max_energy_above_hull": 0.3,
  "max_per_composition": 3,
  "save_directory": "/Users/n0w0f/git/n0w0f_2026/corral_fixes/corral/workdir/5/ml_oxides_trial_7/polymorph_data"
